title: Artifact, Value, or Assumption?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Sort eight statements about a school into Schein's three layers of culture: artifacts, espoused values, and basic assumptions.

learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish eight statements about a school as cultural artifacts, espoused values, or basic assumptions, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Cultural artifacts, espoused values, basic assumptions, and culture assessment, from the section "Culture, Assessed" in Chapter 18.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: The school day is divided into fifty-minute periods. Which layer?
The handbook says parents are partners. Which layer?
commonMisconceptions: The mission statement describes the culture
A visible practice is the same as a belief
Basic assumptions can be read off the walls
assessmentOpportunities: The school day is divided into fifty-minute periods. Which layer?
The handbook says parents are partners. Which layer?
Can basic assumptions be read off the walls?
Is a visible practice the same as a belief?

controls.name: 3 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the layers; two tries per statement.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Opens a table of the layers and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
